name: Portal Market-Data Sourcing Strategy (YCharts vs Bloomberg-PKL vs SmartX)
description: Andrew-direct directive 2026-05-20 (CEO interview with 0.1.0_DS_MarketIntelligence + the ycharts.com.har 92MB capture). Goal: determine, surface by surface, which portal market-data surfaces currently fed by the manual Bloomberg pkl yang-pipeline could instead be sourced by a daily automated YCharts pull, and which must remain manual Bloomberg pkl -- the end-state is an explicit hybrid. Also evaluates whether model-portfolio performance is better sourced from YCharts /model_portfolios/*, the yang model.pkl, or the SmartX backend. Operational model: replicate the Orion/Eclipse manual-credential-refresh + Secrets-Manager pattern, adapted for YCharts (CTO HAR finding, independently corroborated by DS 0.1.0: YCharts is a Django session-cookie web app behind AWS WAF -- NOT a JWT-bearer API; the operational pattern transfers, the credential type does not). This is a feasibility + audit project: v0.1 charters four parallel Phase-0 audits (WS-A YCharts backend, WS-B portal/yang surfaces, WS-C operational pattern, WS-D SmartX model portfolios); the implementation PRD v0.2 is authored by the CTO from the audit synthesis (WS-E / TO-5). v0.1 authorizes NO code/Terraform/Lambda/portal change. Project code MDSRC = Market Data SouRCing (DS 0.1.0 mnemonic), prefixed with the YALP macro (Yang pipeline) per the {MACRO}_{6CHAR} convention.
phase: Phase 0 -- AUDIT CHARTER. PRD v0.1 SHIPPED 2026-05-20 (1.0.0_SA_CTO). Five workstreams decomposed: WS-A YCharts backend endpoint+capability audit (DS 0.1.0); WS-B portal data-surface audit yang-pipeline fed (AE 0.5.0); WS-C YCharts operational-pattern declaration from the Orion/Eclipse baseline (AE 0.7.0); WS-D SmartX backend audit for model-portfolio performance (0.4.0_DS_ClientPlatform SmartX-owner lane, coordinates with MDPF_ASSETS); WS-E CTO synthesis -> migration decision matrix + integration architecture -> PRD v0.2 (gated on WS-A..D). CTO HAR reconnaissance complete + independently corroborated by DS 0.1.0's recon brief docs/briefs/ycharts-bloomberg-portal-data-sourcing-audit-20260520.md (3987616d8). YCharts endpoints inventoried (indices incl. Bloomberg family, fund/security time series, model portfolios, 3MB calculations catalog, classifications, attribution); auth = Django session cookie + CSRF + AWS WAF token (no JWT). Awaiting COO decomposition + Andrew GO for Phase 0 dispatch.
blocking: None -- PRD v0.1 shipped, handed to COO for TO decomposition. Phase 0 TO-1..4 dispatch on Andrew GO. Open Andrew calls Q1 (official YCharts API vs session-scrape) + Q7 (ToS on programmatic extraction) gate Phase 2 implementation, not the Phase 0 audits.
